title: MMS1 dayside outbound pass, 2017-12-01
description: MMS1 on 2017-12-01 09-19 UT leaves the dayside magnetosphere through the magnetopause near 11:34 UT, crosses the magnetosheath and then crosses the bow shock seven times (13:54-14:36 UT) before staying in the solar wind.
